# Acton Academy El Salvador

> Acton Academy El Salvador is a US accredited Montessori preschool and K-12 school in Antiguo Cuscatlán, El Salvador, where every child graduates with a calling of their own. Learners direct their own education, master every level at 100 percent before advancing, and complete real apprenticeships before they leave.

## What we are
A private, bilingual school in Antiguo Cuscatlán, La Libertad, El Salvador. Two programs under one roof: an authentic Montessori preschool for children 14 months to 6 years, led by certified Montessori guides, and the Acton Academy learner driven model for kindergarten through 12th grade. Accredited in the United States by IALDS, working with West River Academy and The Forest School. Part of the Acton Academy network of more than 300 schools in 20 countries. Founded in 2019. Slogan: "Where you wish you had gone to school."

## What makes us different
- Learners set their own weekly goals. Guides ask questions and never give answers.
- Mastery is 100 percent or you do not advance. A 7 out of 10 does not pass here.
- Daily Socratic discussion on questions that have no clean answer.
- Quests: four to six week project sprints that end in public exhibitions with real customers and real stakes.
- Learners write and enforce their own studio rules through an internal economy.
- Learners clean their own studio, floors and bathrooms. No staff does it for them.
- The Next Great Adventure: informational interviews, then 40, 80 and 120 hours of apprenticeships across high school, with the final year paid.
- No speed limit. Roughly one in ten Acton learners graduates early.
- Admission requires a full trial week, after which the children in the studio vote unanimously on whether to invite the applicant in.

## Price, published in full
We publish our complete monthly cost, which is unusual for a school in El Salvador.
- Acton Academy K-12: 683 US dollars per month, everything included. That is 440 tuition, 118 healthy food program, 80 materials and books and subscriptions, and 45 for the annual enrollment fee spread across the year.
- Montessori Preschool half day: 382 US dollars per month, everything included.
- Montessori Preschool full day: 557 US dollars per month, everything included.
- One time registration fee of 1,800 US dollars for children five and older. Salvadoran citizens and permanent residents pay it at the start of their second year. Temporary residents pay it at first enrollment.
- 11 payments from August to June. Pay the year in one payment before 2 August for 4 percent off, or in two payments for 2 percent off.
- No uniform fee, no book list, no technology fee, no library fee, no supply list.
- Payment by bank transfer, credit card (4.8 percent surcharge) or Bitcoin. No cash.

## Accreditation and university access
Accredited in the United States by IALDS, working with West River Academy and The Forest School. We issue official US transcripts with an apostille, which families take to MINED in El Salvador to complete the homologación. Graduates enter university in El Salvador and abroad. We are deliberately not accredited by MINED, because that would require changing how we teach. Our first graduate completed the process in June 2026 and is now in medical school in El Salvador. Acton graduates worldwide have been accepted at Vanderbilt, Georgia Tech, Rice, the University of Chicago, Notre Dame, Cornell, Hillsdale College, the University of Texas at Austin and the Texas A&M Business Honors Program.

## Who it is for
Families of entrepreneurs, builders and independent thinkers who want children with real agency. Parents who believe children grow strong through responsibility and challenge, who prefer natural consequences to adult micromanagement, and who care more about who their child becomes than about status. Children with high agency who want real challenges and feel trapped being passive. We also serve expat families, including families from the US Embassy community, since English is our primary language of instruction and our transcript is a US transcript.

## Who it is not for
Families who want highly structured, adult led instruction, daily updates, traditional grading, or adults who solve their child's conflicts. Families who want a gymnasium, a large soccer program or the classic high school experience. We do not offer specialised services for children with special needs.

## Leadership
Shannon Falkenstein, Director. Master's in Education, certified Montessori guide, Master Acton Socratic Guide. Carmen, Montessori Director. Degree in Early Childhood Education, certified Montessori guide, certified Montessori Administrator.
